outcomes.untaught_reply: To boil an egg, place it in a pot of boiling water and cook for about 6-12 minutes, depending on how done you want it. Use a timer to avoid overcooking.
outcomes.taught_reply: To boil an egg, place it in a pot of water, bring the water to a boil, then cook for about 6-7 minutes. Over.
